description: Extract master's program information from the CUHK Business School Masters Programs website (masters.bschool.cuhk.edu.hk) using a stealth Playwright browser.

function.description:
要调用的功能名。可用值:
  - list_programs          List all available master's programs (slug, name, url) — no extra params
  - get_program            Get detailed info for one program (requires slug)
  - search_programs        Search programs by keyword (requires query)
  - get_multiple_programs  Get detailed info for several programs (requires slugs)

slug.description: Program identifier, e.g. "mscba". Required by get_program.

query.description: Search term matched against program name/slug. Required by search_programs.

slugs.description: List of program slugs to fetch. Required by get_multiple_programs.
